headline: Zimmer Biomet Beats Q3 Estimates and Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: Zimmer Biomet reported third-quarter financial results that surpassed analyst estimates and subsequently raised its corporate earnings guidance.
why: Medical technology companies rely on procedural volumes and new product adoption; upward guidance revisions signal strong demand in orthopedics and healthcare sectors.

impacts.name: Zimmer Biomet Holdings
impacts.why: Beating consensus earnings estimates and raising forward guidance directly boosts investor expectations and stock valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Earnings beats combined with guidance upgrades typically attract strong institutional buying interest and positive analyst revisions.
